--- /dev/null
+++ b/src/installer/service.py
@@ -0,0 +1,40 @@
+from typing import Any, Callable, Dict
+
+# Static channel registry mapping channel names to handler callables
+_CHANNEL_REGISTRY: Dict[str, Callable[..., Any]] = {}
+
+
+def register_channel(channel_name: str, handler: Callable[..., Any]) -> None:
+    """Register a handler callable for a specific channel name.
+
+    Parameters:
+    - channel_name: The name of the channel.
+    - handler: A callable that handles the payload.
+    """
+    _CHANNEL_REGISTRY[channel_name] = handler
+
+
+def dispatch(channel_name: str, payload: dict) -> Any:
+    """Dispatch a payload to the registered handler for the given channel name.
+
+    Supports Service.method routing conventions if the channel or handler is structured accordingly.
+    Raises KeyError if the channel is not registered.
+    """
+    handler = _CHANNEL_REGISTRY.get(channel_name)
+    if handler is None:
+        raise KeyError(f"Channel '{channel_name}' is unregistered.")
+    return handler(payload)
+
+
+class Service:
+    """Service pattern API support for method routing and dispatching."""
+
+    @staticmethod
+    def register(channel_name: str, handler: Callable[..., Any]) -> None:
+        """Static method to register a channel handler."""
+        register_channel(channel_name, handler)
+
+    @staticmethod
+    def dispatch(channel_name: str, payload: dict) -> Any:
+        """Static method to dispatch payload to a channel handler."""
+        return dispatch(channel_name, payload)
